email_subject: Application - Digital Marketing Intern at Fermedics
email_body:
Dear Fermedics team,

I saw your internship for a Digital Marketing Intern and wanted to reach out. I'm a digital marketer who builds SEO strategies that get results: at Episto I helped a client rank #4 on Google Turkey for "PDKS," and I've built ~600 member profile pages on one consistent layout. I also run my own Google Ads tests, like the one for a kids' bike brand that earned a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks.

Your focus on fermented botanical ingredients and the B2B supplement market is exactly the kind of science-driven niche I want to work in. I use Semrush daily, write in English fluently, and I'm comfortable with Canva and WordPress. I live in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and have my own car, so getting to your Ghent office is easy.

I'd love to talk about how I can help you build a content plan and grow your Instagram presence.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Fermedics team,

When I read that you're a Ghent-based scale-up making fermented botanical ingredients for supplement brands, I immediately thought of the Google Ads test I ran for a kids' bike brand: I built two Dutch landing pages, chose buyer-intent keywords, and the campaign earned a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks. That mix of hands-on execution and commercial thinking is what I'd bring to your digital marketing internship.

At Episto, I help client businesses rank for the searches their buyers make. I've seen a client hit #4 on page 1 of Google Turkey for "PDKS," and I built and launched around 600 member profile pages on one consistent layout for a pharmacists' association. I also use Semrush daily for keyword research, technical SEO audits, and tracking rankings, traffic, and CTR. On the content side, I've written website copy in English, Dutch, and French, and I've used Canva to create visuals for client campaigns.

What draws me to Fermedics is the intersection of health, food, and science. I've built my own products with AI, including a dog-care app on Google Play and fitness and nutrition trackers, so I understand how real users find, try, and stick with a product. I'm also curious about AI search: I've done GEO work to help websites appear in LLM results, which aligns with your goal of being found by both Google and models like Claude and ChatGPT.

I work in English every day and I write and speak Dutch at a working level. I live in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and have my own car, so the daily trip to your Ghent office is no problem.

In the first weeks, I'd dive into Semrush to spot SEO gaps, map out your sales funnel, and draft a content plan for your newsletter, Instagram, and LinkedIn. I'd also start growing your Instagram account by sharing behind-the-scenes stories of your fermented ingredients and the supplement brands you work with.

I'd love to talk about how I can help you build a real digital marketing strategy. Let's schedule a call.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
baverok.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## SUMMARY

At Episto I run SEO for consulting, auto and e-commerce clients, and as a freelancer I sell AI search visibility and marketing automation, with a free site check as the first step. I built kxp.be single-handedly in WordPress with on-page SEO and GEO in three languages, and I use Semrush, GA4 and Search Console daily. I am analytical, follow algorithm updates closely and want to turn that ownership into more customers for a growing B2B team.

- Run keyword research, local and mobile SEO and link building for consulting, auto and e-commerce clients
- Track KPIs (rankings, traffic, CTR) in Semrush, Ahrefs, GA4 and Search Console and report on results

- **#4 on page 1** of Google Turkey for "PDKS" (access-control software), as part of the agency team

### Freelance Digital Marketer – [baverok.com](https://baverok.com), 09/2026 – Present

## PROJECTS & PRODUCTS

### AI job-search assistant

### Tabağım – calorie and health tracker

- **SEO & marketing:** SEO strategy, keyword research, on-page, technical, AI search (GEO/AEO), SEO audits, content marketing, local and mobile SEO, link building, schema markup, Google Ads Search, WooCommerce
- **Growth & sales:** lead generation, landing pages, client discovery meetings, offers and proposals, A/B testing
